video.title: IBM AI Racing League | 65.968s Autonomous Racing Lap | TORCS
video.description: The final P1 controller driving one standing-start lap of the Corkscrew circuit in TORCS: 65.968 s with zero damage. A single recording of the race, with a title card before the start and a credit card after the results.
video.accessibilityNote: An 80-second recording with no audio track; this description covers the picture only. It opens on the starting grid with the word Ready and a title card reading "IBM AI Racing League, Final AI Controller, 65.968 s" and below it "TORCS, Corkscrew, 1 lap from a standing start, damage 0". A blue single-seater race car with the IBM name is then followed from behind through the whole Corkscrew circuit, with a track map, timer and damage panel, and speed and rpm gauges on screen. It ends on the TORCS Race Results screen: Corkscrew, one lap, total and best time 01:05:96, top speed 293, damages 0, followed by a card reading "Youssef Studio, youssef.studio".
video.posterAlt: The blue IBM race car on the Corkscrew circuit in TORCS at 256 km/h, with the speed and rpm gauges, track map and timer on screen.
